QuestInfo.name: Lilin's Account
QuestInfo.0: Now that you're safely in town, you should listen to #b#p1201000#'s#k account of what happened in the past, and how you became a hero in the first place.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1201000#, a few hundred years ago, a group of #bheroes#k valiantly fought against the #rBlack Mage#k who controlled Maple World. Apparently, you're one of them. But because of the Black Mage's curse, you lost your memories and abilities, and were frozen in ice until you were awakened just recently.
QuestInfo.2: According to #p1201000#, a few hundred years ago, a group of #bheroes#k valiantly fought against the #rBlack Mage#k, who controlled Maple World. Apparently, you're one of them. no.0: You must be a bit overwhelmed with everything that I threw at you just now. If you didn't catch it all, I'm more than happy to tell you the story once more. Tell me when you're ready.
